# Mediabunny 1.61.3 (unmodified)

`mediabunny.min.mjs` is the unmodified `dist/bundles/mediabunny.min.mjs` from the
npm package `mediabunny@1.61.3` (https://mediabunny.dev, source:
https://github.com/Vanilagy/mediabunny). Licensed under the Mozilla Public
License 2.0 (see `LICENSE`). Used only by `js/huh-export.js` (the Download
button) to demux the cat clip, decode/encode with WebCodecs and mux MP4/MOV.
It is loaded on first use, never on page load.
